name: tshark
title: TShark (Wireshark)
description: Packet capture analysis with Wireshark's TShark 4.4: capture summary (capinfos), protocol hierarchy, conversations, endpoints, packets with display filters and chosen fields, TCP/UDP/HTTP stream contents, HTTP requests, DNS queries and clear-text credentials. Captures (.pcap, .pcapng) are read from the folder mounted at /work. No network: TShark only reads files, never captures and never resolves names.
license: MIT (MCP server, axross-mcp-hub) AND GPL-2.0-or-later (Wireshark/TShark, Debian package)

mounts.description: The folder with the capture files (read-only is enough)

notes: Display filters and field names are validated and passed as single arguments; a capture is parsed by Wireshark's dissectors inside the container (no capabilities, no network).
